summary: Noah Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a monthly return under Hong Kong Exchange Listing Rules on movements in its securities for April 2026. The filing reports no change in issued shares (337,233,937 ordinary shares outstanding) and confirms compliance with the public float requirement. It also details share options outstanding under the 2022 Share Incentive Plan, which had zero movement during the month. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing contains no transaction, event, or corporate action meeting the special-situations criteria. As a non-US issuer, this corresponds to an ordinary periodic report.
